consult r2 returned a VALID REWORK (marker form). Two required changes, both verified by the orchestrator before closing: (C1) a tracked symlink pointing at an untracked JSON bypasses a logical-path-only tracking check (measured: ls-files reports the symlink tracked and its target untracked, while reading the symlink yields the untracked content); (C2) S1b's runtime-fixture escape hatch is unimplementable -- equal branch fields always rev-parse to the same commit, and macOS is case-insensitive so `git branch Main` errors as already-existing.

After WP-02 reached APPROVED_FOR_MERGE, main_repo() was proven to always resolve to the physical primary checkout, so WP-02 cannot standard-finalize from the linked plan worktree. PLAN lint simultaneously blocks convergence on the historical sync commits that WP-03 is designed to exempt. Requiring WP-02 to be MERGED before WP-03 therefore creates a real dependency cycle. User explicitly approved restoring WP-03; rev4 changes only this execution dependency, not any invariant, case, mutation, scope, or residual risk.

Orchestrator independently reproduced normal exit 0 matching TRACKED.status.json versus `git --literal-pathspecs` exit 1. rev6 adds E9 form 5 and M-2e.

The mutation repo was also incorrectly fixed to physical-primary, which is off-target and carries unrelated user changes. rev7 binds trust to the integration branch committed blob and executes merge in the caller's registered target worktree.
